headline: CZ Warns of AI-Driven Hacks Following Binance's $6.4 Billion Heist
summary: Following Binance's historic $6.4 billion heist, CZ warned of more AI-driven hacks, noting that automated tools lower the barrier for complex breaches.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and security breaches involving billions of dollars have systemic implications for digital asset markets and regulatory scrutiny.
why_moved: Massive security breaches at major cryptocurrency exchanges create systemic concerns regarding digital asset security and can suppress crypto asset valuations.
